chunking.splitRule: Split in ascending stable index order into consecutive chunks of at most 64 positions; never split one position's at-most-eight legs across chunks.

sourceIdentity.unresolvedReason: The current ResourceArrival key is (structure_id, day) with nested slots, while the frozen mutation ABI exposes arrival_id; no canonical slot-to-arrival identity projection exists.
Military and cargo values span explorer, army, guard, ownership, and nested cargo records; the current candidate tuple has no reviewed discriminator or exact model-key projection.
The Trade key is trade_id and the frozen mutation ABI uses order_id, but DONKEY and resource escrow subpositions have no frozen discriminator or exact source projection.
Bank, market, AMM, and LP values use different keyed models; no reviewed pool/owner/kind discriminator projects every value-bearing position exactly once.
Reward, Faith, prize, fee, and participant state uses heterogeneous keys; player_id/reward_kind does not identify every affected value-bearing record.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Sum every sealed resource-bearing entity class's lifetime allocations multiplied by its approved resource-position set.
requiredInputs: lifetime allocation cap for every resource-bearing entity class
sealed ordered resource registry and allocation policy
preset-specific structure, troop, bank, mine, quest, and participant caps
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject before any Resource, Weight, backing, index, or ExitPosition mutation; tombstones never return capacity.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Count lifetime economically active Structure IDs across every allowed category; ownership transfers do not increase the count.
requiredInputs: maximum accepted realm and participant registrations
sealed per-category structure creation limits
destroyed-structure terminal and recreation policy
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject structure creation before Structure, owner-stat, resource, map, backing, index, or ExitPosition writes.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Sum each lifetime approved producer entity's sealed production-enabled resource set.

cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject before rate, output, Resource, Weight, backing, Building, index, or ExitPosition mutation; replace unbounded labor output with the sealed-end ceiling.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Count every admitted arrival resource leg over the game lifetime, not only concurrently retained day buckets.

maximum resources per transfer and every arrival-producing operation
explicit lifetime arrival-position cap
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject atomically before resource debit, DONKEY burn, backing reservation, arrival bucket mutation, or acceptance event.

agent current and lifetime caps

cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject before troop payment, UUID publication, sponsor credit, guard or cargo mutation, backing, index, or ExitPosition change.

cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject before resource debit, DONKEY burn, backing reservation, order UUID, TradeCount, Trade, index, or ExitPosition mutation.

cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject before reserve, share, Resource, Weight, backing-lot, pending-liability, index, or ExitPosition mutation.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Sum the independently frozen maxima of every typed reward subtype and every supporting record required by finalization.
requiredInputs: sealed reward subtype registry and supporting-record policy
phase, trial, wonder, rank, chest, participant, and sponsor maxima
fixed season timing and admitted structure/player counts
claimed, paid, zeroed, and recreated source policies
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject before source value, backing, quota, cursor, claimed state, pending liability, index, or ExitPosition mutation while preserving existing finalization and exits.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Sum every irreversible source-position debit generation that creates a liability plus finalizer-created ordinary withdrawal liabilities.
requiredInputs: reviewed maxima for all source families
liability-producing generation cap per source or one game-global lifetime cap
forced-exit and finalizer decomposition maxima
maximum-witness UnsealedPending and open BatchAssigned states
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject liability creation before source debit, generation, backing-lot, index, or journal mutation; existing append, seal, claim, and recovery remain available.

cardinalityReviews.formula: At most 64 active-backing parent keys multiplied by 64 contiguous lots per parent.
requiredInputs: sealed parent registry limited to 64
immutable per-parent lot count limited to 64
review of fixed parent-index and lot-index coordinates against the generic family index
cardinalityReviews.candidateEvidence: Normative protocol limits provide 64 parents by 64 lots, but the fixed coordinate has not been reconciled with the generic append-only index.
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject a sixty-fifth parent or lot before local credit, backing, index, or ExitPosition mutation.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Count unique economically addressable player_l2 values admitted during the game lifetime.

first-participation versus first-lock allocation rule
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject participation or first lock before any source, backing, index, or ExitPosition mutation.

cardinalityReviews.formula: Add initial positions projected from families 1 through 11 to every permitted split child and merge output over the game lifetime.
requiredInputs: reviewed maxima for families 1 through 11
split fan-out and merge fan-in limits
per-position and per-game lifetime reshape caps
eager versus lazy source-position creation policy
cardinalityReviews.capExhaustion: Reject create, split, or merge before source, owner index, backing, generation, tombstone, or child mutation.

reviewFindings.detail: The reference layout freezes u64 allocation, generation, tombstone, and chunk semantics. Seven interface-backed candidate encodings are typed but are not exact source projections, and five heterogeneous families remain unresolved; reviewed per-family maxima and production ExitPosition/PositionRef/PlayerPositionIndex writers remain absent.

implementationIssues.scope: resource, ownership, production, backing, player lock, and canonical exit-position foundations
troops, explorers, guards, ownership/capture, and cargo
bank, AMM, LP, fees, and pending withdrawals
fees, prizes, Faith, Blitz participant, and reward state

releaseBlockers.detail: The reviewed A9 scan is conservative, but exact source-to-ExitPosition projections remain unimplemented and therefore cannot serve as a production writer map.
Candidate source identity tuples are not backed by implemented monotonic family indexes, generations, and tombstones.
Arrivals, military/cargo, trade/DONKEY, AMM/LP, and reward state do not yet have exact typed identities that cover their heterogeneous source model keys.
No reviewed ruleset or simulation-derived maximum position count exists for any family, so A8 has no canonical maximum witness and production has no cap to enforce.
Pending-withdrawal, active-backing, player-lock, and canonical ExitPosition families have no production writers yet.
